text_block_list.name: Junior-Class Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~, so many reporters!
Heheh, I've gotta show them some good running too!

text_block_list.name: Junior-Class Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaah~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Splendid...! This year's newcomers are just brimming with so much individuality...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Who are you keeping an eye on, Ms. Otonashi?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'd have to say
Gold Ship-san, wouldn't you?!
And then there's the talk about her bloodshot eyes in her debut race—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! She was there, alright!
With that totally headstrong look on her face!
Like she was putting pressure on her Trainer too...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss, your next orders!!
choice_data_list: To handle the tight turns, let's try increasing our cadence.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You give off a completely different impression.
Much more serious, or should I say...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Crime Scene Investigation"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, thank you very much.
Even giving me a scalp massage...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...You've truly thought of everything.
From the coaching to helping with bloodshot eyes."
choice_data_list: Because I want everyone to see how cool you are.
Because I want everyone to see how cool you are.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall certainly live up to
those expectations as well."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ we take on today
is the stage that crowns the strongest Junior-class Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —In a manner befitting an ally of justice, I shall claim the radiant glory of 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"And reversing all the bad reputation,
I will begin taking the right steps!"
